verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented way for Mastra agents to connect to or consume external MCP servers. The only MCP evidence (mastra-docs-19) covers authoring and exposing MCP servers, which is the server role, not client-side consumption. Native tool registration (mastra-docs-2) is a separate capability and does not transfer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
